description_en: Modifies the BGP configurations of an SCG5000 or SCG5000-5G device whose version is 3.4.2 or later
description_zh: 修改SAG设备动态路由协议BGP的配置，适用于设备类型为SCG5000或SCG5000-5G的智能接入网关实例，且设备版本为3.4.2及以上
kebab_example: aliyun smartag update-smart-access-gateway-bgp-route --sag-ins-id sag-v9un1ccz22owd70000 --sag-sn sagf4dk0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --router-id 172.XX.XX.1 --local-as 65536 --hold-time 9 --keep-alive 3 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateSmartAccessGatewayBgpRoute

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Smart Access Gateway (SAG) instance
parameters.name: sag_ins_id

parameters.help_en: The serial number of the SAG device
parameters.help_zh: 智能接入网关设备序列号
parameters.name: sag_sn

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the SAG instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69813.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
智能接入网关实例所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69813.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the BGP router
parameters.name: router_id

parameters.help_en:
The autonomous system number (ASN) of the SAG device.

Valid values: 1 to 4294967295
parameters.help_zh:
智能接入网关设备所属自治系统编号。

取值范围：1~4294967295
parameters.name: local_as

parameters.help_en:
The hold time. Unit: seconds.

Valid values: 3 to 65535.

When the SAG device establishes a peering connection with a peer device, the hold time of both devices must be the same. If the SAG device does not receive a keepalive or update message from the peer device within the hold time, the connection between the BGP peers is closed
parameters.help_zh:
保持时间。单位：秒。

取值范围：3~65535。

在智能接入网关设备和对端设备建立对等体关系时，两端设备要协商Hold Time并保持一致，如果在Hold Time内未收到对端发来的KeepAlive或Update消息，则认为BGP连接中断
parameters.name: hold_time

parameters.help_en:
The time interval at which keep-alive packets are sent. Unit: seconds.

Valid values: 0 to 65535
parameters.help_zh:
存活时间间隔。单位：秒。

取值范围：0~65535
parameters.name: keep_alive

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to query only the SAG instances that belong to another Alibaba Cloud account. Valid values:

false (default)
true
parameters.help_zh:
是否只查询跨账号所属的智能接入网关实例。取值：

false（默认值）：否。

true：是
parameters.name: cross_account

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the SAG instance belongs
parameters.help_zh: 智能接入网关实例所属的阿里云账号（主账号）ID
parameters.name: resource_uid

Code.description_en: The response code. A value of 200 indicates that the task is successful
Code.description_zh: 响应码。200标识查询任务成功

Message.description_en: The response message. A value of Successful indicates that the task is successful
Message.description_zh: 响应消息。Successful标识查询任务成功

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call is successful. Valid values:

true
false
Success.description_zh:
修改是否成功。取值：

true：是。
false：否
